title: Perceives but Doesn't Brake: A Perception-Action Binding Gap in Reasoning Driving VLAs
abstract: arXiv:2610.28184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) driving models can perceive and reason about safety-critical hazards yet fail to translate that evidence into safe actions. We characterize this failure as a perception-action binding gap: hazard information is available inside the model but exerts insufficient control over trajectory generation. Using matched simulated counterfactuals and logged driving replay, we show that in-path hazards are actually encoded in the visual representation, but longitudinal plans are dominated by ego-speed history and respond only weakly to hazard proximity or the model's own reasoning trace. Further analysis shows that the trajectory generator is capable of braking but sometimes fails to do so due to the perception-action binding gap. translated_title: 能感知却不刹车：推理型驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型中的感知-动作绑定缺口
translated_abstract: 推理增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驾驶模型能够感知安全关键的危险并进行推理，却无法将这些证据转化为安全动作。我们将这种失效表征为“感知-动作绑定缺口”：危险信息在模型内部是可用的，但对轨迹生成的控制力不足。借助匹配的模拟反事实实验与真实驾驶回放数据，我们证明路径内的危险实际上已被编码进视觉表征中，但纵向规划主要由自车速度历史所主导，对危险逼近程度或模型自身的推理轨迹仅响应微弱。进一步分析表明，轨迹生成器本身具备刹车能力，却因感知-动作绑定缺口而有时未能刹车。在无需重新训练或修改任何权重的情况下，我们向 Alpamayo-1.5 的冻结流匹配采样器中注入危险条件化的能量，从而恢复了缺失的耦合。
tldr: 该论文发现推理型驾驶VLA模型存在“感知-动作绑定缺口”——模型虽能感知并推理危险却无法据此刹车，并提出通过向冻结流匹配采样器注入危险条件化能量这一免训练方法来修复该缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a "perception-action binding gap" in reasoning driving VLAs—hazard information is perceived and reasoned about but fails to control trajectory generation—and proposes a training-free fix by injecting hazard-conditioned energy into the frozen flow-matching sampler.
